subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should detailed Cursor usage-event history require a dedicated explicit opt-in, or may the existing enabled-provider and Show cost summary settings authorize this expanded cookie-authenticated fetch?
rationale: Implementation quality cannot determine whether existing settings constitute consent for a new account-wide remote data source, and the repository owner explicitly held merge for this choice.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a disabled-by-default Cursor history setting with clear remote account-wide source wording and upgrade-safe behavior.

options.title: Reuse existing settings
options.body: Approve provider enablement plus Show cost summary as sufficient consent and retain the current network behavior.

options.title: Keep summary-only
options.body: Decline detailed event-history collection and leave Cursor limited to existing summary and status data.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a disabled-by-default Cursor history setting with clear remote account-wide source wording and upgrade-safe behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner explicitly requested this decision and has reviewed and edited the affected implementation.
